title: setting bottom price for dynamic price ranges
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js, I could not find what I was looking for which is: -- PLEASE FILL IN HERE --

I understand that the price ranges in the price ranges widget are set dynamically. However, this can give a rather ugly bottom price, especially because we are basically a high price range shop. But we have less expensive products too.

It would be cool to set 50 as the bottom price.
